endorsements.quote: We are calling for medical schools and residencies to adjust their curricula to include AI, interpreting AI-generated insights and making informed decisions based on evidence-based, validated algorithmic outputs.

unlisted_practices: Establish a Practice-Based Research Network-like community for family medicine to test, refine, evaluate, and implement AI-driven tools.
Establish a centralized innovation center for AI implementation offering standardized protocols, best practices, and a repository of validated AI applications.
Engage clinicians, educators, researchers, administrators, and national organizations to collaboratively develop AI guidelines and standards.
National family medicine associations should provide leadership and financial support for AI integration efforts.
Incorporate an antidiscrimination lens into AI through the detection and prevention of biased data.
Ensure systems interacting with patient data adhere to rigorous standards of ethics and HIPAA compliance.
Conduct ongoing research on AI's impact on the Quintuple Aim, including costs and implementation barriers and opportunities.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article discussing how family medicine should prepare for, integrate, and govern AI technologies.
